name: Integrated Solutions Technology, Inc.
summary: Integrated Solutions Technology, Inc. specializes in providing integrated circuit (IC) drivers specifically for the flat panel display sector. Their comprehensive product line includes EPD/ESL driver ICs, which are engineered for graphic and segment display applications. The company also manufactures STN/TN single-chip driver ICs, serving a diverse range of uses such as electronic shelf labels (ESL), wearable technology, automotive systems, instrumentation, and devices employing capacitive display components. Additionally, they offer STN SEG/COM drive ICs, commonly found in personal digital assistants (PDAs), e-books, gaming consoles, and various instrument displays. Their portfolio is completed with PMOLED driver ICs, likewise designed for wearable devices and instrumentation requirements. Established in 1988, Integrated Solutions Technology, Inc. is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
